title: 第1565章 暗流14第1564章 暗流13
content_zh:
达门直接说道：“找借口很容易。”
“借口！？之前谁教你的？达门？”张佛不乐意的反问道。
昏暗的实验室廊道里，空气凝滞而压抑，每一寸氛围都被紧绷的对峙牢牢攥住。张佛缓缓抬步，一步步逼近身前的达门，眼底翻涌着极致的自负与强势，目光死死锁定对方，一字一句，冰冷铿锵地开口：“你所知的一切，尽数是我亲手教的。你的所有能力、你的手段、你的底气，都是我一步步塑造出来的。既然我能造就你，今日，我也自然能亲手打败你。”
他身姿挺拔，周身裹挟着凌厉的压迫感，直面达门发起对峙，将所有人的注意力牢牢牵引在二人的交锋之上。在场众人的目光尽数聚焦在这场对峙之中，神情紧绷，无人分心，谁也没有察觉到角落里蛰伏的作家。趁着全场注意力高度集中、无人顾及周遭的绝佳空档，作家眸光微动，压下心底的波澜，身形悄无声息地偏移，脚步轻盈且迅速，稳稳挪到墙面的主控操作台旁。他垂落的指尖掠过冰冷的设备外壳，随后精准落在控制面板的线路与按键之上，指腹翻飞，动作隐秘而利落，快速完成了一连串细微却关键的操作，全程毫无声响，没有任何人察觉这场暗中的干预。
就在两人对峙的话音落下的瞬间，一阵细微的滋滋电流杂音骤然从线路中传出，微弱的异响刚起，便被密闭的空间放大。下一秒，整片手术室连带廊道的照明设备瞬间失效，明亮的光线骤然尽数褪去，浓稠如墨的黑暗如同潮水般汹涌席卷而来，彻底吞噬了室内所有的光亮。方才还略显喧嚣的空间瞬间落入死寂，空气骤然沉了下来，昏暗笼罩了每一个角落，视野彻底陷入漆黑。
手术室内，两名全副戒备、死死按压着波丽的安保助手，被这场突如其来的断电彻底打乱了节奏。原本紧绷禁锢的动作骤然僵在半空，身体下意识地一顿，神情瞬间变得警惕而慌乱。突如其来的黑暗让他们视野尽失，无法再牢牢掌控局面。沉寂的黑暗中，其中一名助手迅速压低声线，语气带着明显的谨慎与凝重，快速低声叮嘱同伴：“张佛向来不会听从达门的调度，局面不受控制了，你立刻去别处搜寻可用的照明设备，尽快恢复光源。”
另一名助手立刻领会事态的紧急，重重颔首，不敢有丝毫耽搁，压低声音快速回应：“旧储物房间里应该存放着备用应急灯具，我现在立刻过去取，很快就回来。”话音落罢，他便弓着身子，借着微弱的环境微光，小心翼翼地朝着门外挪动，准备前去取设备。
留守下来的助手快速收敛了心中的慌乱，强装镇定，缓缓调整好状态。他转头看向被牢牢禁锢在手术台边、动弹不得的波丽，刻意放缓了语调，看似温和安抚，实则字字裹挟着冰冷的威慑力，试图击溃对方的心理防线：“别害怕，囚犯，我们不会让你在这里无谓等待太久，所有流程很快就会彻底结束，你不必徒劳挣扎。”
就在这间手术室陷入昏暗、两人各司其职、氛围稍稍松懈的关键时刻，一道纤细轻盈的人影借着无边的黑暗遮掩，屏息凝神，一步一顿悄然靠近手术台边。来人正是一直潜伏待命、伺机营救波丽的阿让，她隐在黑暗盲区之中，全程隐匿行踪，耐心等待着最佳的出手时机。
留守的助手在昏暗之中隐约看清了来人的身形轮廓，认出是自己阵营的人，心底的警惕瞬间消散大半，彻底放下了防备。他随意地抬手摆了摆，语气松懈，毫无戒备地吩咐道：“是你啊，姑娘，来得正好。我现在要去排查电路故障、检查保险丝，尽快抢修恢复灯光，你暂且留在这儿，专心盯紧这名囚犯，千万不要让她趁机挣脱、闹出任何差错。”
阿让面无表情，神色平静无波，默默轻轻点了点头，顺从地应声，完美伪装出安分待命的模样。随后她缓步上前，脚步轻柔无声，缓缓走到波丽身侧，指尖极其轻柔、带着隐秘的深意，轻轻落在了波丽的肩头。这个动作看似是看守的戒备压制，实则是暗中安抚、传递信号，隐秘又稳妥，没有引起身旁助手的丝毫怀疑。
即将动身离去的助手依旧没有放松对波丽的警告，他再次转头看向被禁锢的少女，方才松懈的语气瞬间骤然冷厉下来，眉眼间覆上一层冰冷的寒意，带着极具压迫感的严厉警告：“安分守己，老老实实待着，别心存侥幸耍任何花招，听懂了吗？但凡你敢有一丝异动，等待你的下场，只会比你现在预想的更加凄惨。”
波丽被全程禁锢，身体动弹不得，又身处漆黑陌生的环境，内心早已被恐惧彻底填满。她浑身微微紧绷颤抖，脊背发凉，心底满是惶恐与不安，面对助手的严厉警告，她不敢有丝毫反抗，只能微微低头，声音细细弱弱，带着难以掩饰的颤抖与怯懦，小心翼翼地回应：“我、我明白。”
得到波丽顺从的答复后，留守的助手才彻底放心，不再停留，转身快步踏出手术室大门，急匆匆前去检修故障电路、排查保险丝问题，一心只想尽快恢复室内照明。随着房门被轻轻带合，空旷漆黑的手术室内彻底没了外人的踪迹，偌大的空间死寂无声，最终只剩下伪装值守的阿让，和依旧被禁锢、满心不安的波丽两人。
周遭万籁俱寂，唯有两人细微的呼吸声在空旷的房间里轻轻回荡。阿让微微俯身，将脸庞凑近波丽的耳畔，摒住气息，用极致轻柔、只有两人能够听清的音量，低低地轻唤了一声：“姑娘。”
耳畔突如其来的轻柔低语打破了死寂，让心绪紧绷的波丽心头骤然一紧，瞬间提起了全部警惕。她强压着心底翻涌的慌乱与恐惧，努力稳住颤抖的呼吸，小声试探着反问：“怎么了？”
“别说话，不要发出任何声音，跟着我，我带你离开这里。”阿让的语气格外沉稳笃定，没有丝毫犹豫，眼底满是坚定的善意与营救的决心，同时微微偏头，用眼神示意波丽配合自己的动作。
波丽聪慧机敏，瞬间读懂了阿让眼底的深意与暗藏的善意，立刻反应过来，眼前的这个人，是冒着风险专程潜入进来营救自己的。绝境之中突如其来的希望，让她紧绷的心神稍稍松动。她立刻用力挣扎着挺直身体、坐直身子，迫不及待想要起身跟随对方逃离此地。可四周漆黑如墨，伸手不见五指，浓郁的黑暗彻底遮蔽了所有视线，她根本无法分辨周遭的环境与前行的方向，寸步难行。
无边无际的黑暗裹挟着未知的恐惧，再度攫住了波丽的心神，让她愈发慌乱无助。她微微蹙着眉，声音带着明显的怯意与茫然，轻声说道：“我……我什么都看不见，根本不知道该往哪里走。”
“别怕，不用慌，伸手握住我的手。我常年在暗处行动，早已习惯了这般无边黑暗，不用担心迷路。动作快一点，抓紧时间，我们必须在那些人抢修完灯光、折返回来之前彻底离开这里。”阿让语气沉稳温柔，句句都在安抚慌乱的波丽，同时催促着抓紧转瞬即逝的逃生机会。

话音落下的瞬间，阿让主动抬起手臂，伸出掌心，稳稳递到波丽的身前。波丽毫不犹豫，立刻抬手紧紧握住那只温热安稳的手掌。掌心传来的温度与笃定的力量，瞬间抚平了她大半的惶恐。两人默契地摒住呼吸，不敢发出半点声响，借着黑暗的掩护，在阿让的牵引之下，身姿轻巧，快步悄然撤离了危机四伏的手术室。
与此同时，另一端的张佛实验室内，对峙的氛围依旧紧绷到了极点，丝毫没有松懈。灯光熄灭之后，这里的气氛愈发压抑凝滞。作家看着窗外暗处悄然发生的一切，心知自己的小动作已经奏效，面上却刻意装作一脸窘迫与茫然。他故作慌乱地抬手拢了拢凌乱的衣角，脸上挂着恰到好处、满是歉意的神情，试图用笨拙的假象掩盖自己刻意的暗中操作，低声解释道：“我也想不明白，今日怎么会变得这般笨拙迟钝，想来应该是方才不小心撞到了设备开关，才误触了线路吧。”
content_en:
Damen said directly: "It's easy to make excuses."
"Excuse!? Who taught you before? Damen?" Zhang Fo asked unhappily.
In the dim laboratory corridor, the air was stagnant and depressing, and every inch of the atmosphere was tightly gripped by a tense confrontation. Zhang Fo slowly raised his steps and approached Damen in front of him step by step. His eyes were filled with extreme pride and strength. He locked his eyes on the other person and said word by word, coldly and sonorously: "Everything you know was taught by me personally. All your abilities, your methods, and your confidence were shaped by me step by step. Since I can cultivate you, today, I can also defeat you with my own hands."
He stood tall and straight, with a strong sense of oppression wrapped around his body. He faced Damen directly and initiated a confrontation, firmly drawing everyone's attention to the confrontation between the two. The eyes of everyone present were focused on this confrontation. Their expressions were tense and no one was distracted. No one noticed the writer dormant in the corner. Taking advantage of the perfect moment when the entire audience was highly focused and no one was paying attention to their surroundings, the writer moved his eyes slightly, suppressed the turmoil in his heart, and moved his body quietly. His steps were light and fast, and he moved steadily to the main control console on the wall. His hanging fingertips brushed across the cold equipment casing, and then landed precisely on the lines and buttons of the control panel. His fingertips flew with secret and neat movements, and he quickly completed a series of subtle but crucial operations. The entire process was silent, and no one noticed this secret intervention.
The moment the words of the confrontation between the two people fell, a subtle sizzling current noise suddenly came from the line. The faint abnormal sound was amplified by the enclosed space as soon as it started. The next second, the lighting equipment in the entire operating room and corridors instantly failed. The bright light suddenly faded away, and the thick, ink-like darkness swept in like a tide, completely swallowing up all the light in the room. The space that was still slightly noisy just now fell into dead silence, the air suddenly became dark, darkness enveloped every corner, and the vision was completely plunged into darkness.
In the operating room, two security assistants who were on full alert and pressing down on Polly were completely disrupted by the sudden power outage. His movements that were originally tight and restrained suddenly froze in mid-air, his body subconsciously paused, and his expression instantly became alert and panicked. The sudden darkness robbed them of their vision and they could no longer firmly control the situation. In the silent darkness, one of the assistants quickly lowered his voice with obvious caution and solemnity, and quickly whispered to his companion: "Zhang Fo never listens to Damen's instructions. The situation is out of control. You should immediately go elsewhere to search for available lighting equipment and restore the light source as soon as possible."
The other assistant immediately understood the urgency of the situation, nodded heavily, and without any delay, lowered his voice and responded quickly: "There should be spare emergency lighting fixtures stored in the old storage room. I will go and get them right away. I will be back soon." After saying this, he hunched over and moved cautiously toward the door with the help of the weak ambient light, preparing to get the equipment.
The assistant who stayed behind quickly calmed down the panic in his heart, pretended to be calm, and slowly adjusted his condition. He turned to look at Polly, who was firmly imprisoned by the operating table, unable to move, and deliberately slowed down his tone. It seemed gentle and comforting, but in fact, every word contained a cold intimidation, trying to break down the other party's psychological defense: "Don't be afraid, prisoner, we won't let you wait here for too long. All procedures will be completed soon, and you don't have to struggle in vain."
At the critical moment when the operating room fell into darkness, the two people were performing their duties, and the atmosphere was slightly relaxed, a slender and light figure, covered by the boundless darkness, quietly approached the operating table step by step, holding his breath and concentrating. The person coming was none other than Arang, who had been waiting for an opportunity to rescue Polly. She hid in the dark blind spot, hiding her whereabouts throughout the whole process, patiently waiting for the best opportunity to take action.
The left-behind assistantIn the dimness, he vaguely saw the outline of the person coming, and recognized that he was from his own camp. Most of the vigilance in his heart disappeared in an instant, and he completely let down his guard. He raised his hand and waved it casually, and ordered in a relaxed tone, without warning: "It's you, girl, you came just in time. I'm going to troubleshoot the circuit fault, check the fuse, and restore the lights as soon as possible. You stay here for the time being and keep an eye on this prisoner. Don't let her break away and make any mistakes."
Arang's face was expressionless and calm. He nodded silently and obeyed, perfectly pretending to be calm and ready. Then she stepped forward slowly, with gentle and soundless steps, and walked slowly to Polly's side. Her fingertips were extremely gentle, with hidden meanings, and gently landed on Polly's shoulder. This action seemed to be a warning and suppression by the guard, but in fact it was a secret comfort and signal transmission. It was secretive and safe, and did not arouse the slightest suspicion from the assistants around him.
The assistant who was about to leave still did not relax his warning to Polly. He turned to look at the imprisoned girl again, and his relaxed tone suddenly became cold and stern. A layer of ice-cold chill covered his brows and eyes, with a very oppressive and stern warning: "Stand by yourself, stay honest, and don't take chances and play any tricks. Do you understand? If you dare to make any changes, the end that awaits you will only be more miserable than you expect now."
Polly was imprisoned throughout the whole process, unable to move her body, and she was in a dark and unfamiliar environment. Her heart was completely filled with fear. Her whole body was slightly tense and trembling, her spine was trembling, and her heart was full of fear and uneasiness. Facing the assistant's stern warning, she did not dare to resist at all. She could only lower her head slightly, her voice was thin and weak, and with unconcealable trembling and cowardice, she cautiously responded: "I, I understand."
After receiving Polly's obedient reply, the assistant who stayed behind was completely reassured and stopped staying. He turned around and quickly walked out of the operating room door, hurriedly going to repair the faulty circuit and troubleshoot the fuse problem. He just wanted to restore the indoor lighting as soon as possible. As the door was gently closed, there was no trace of outsiders in the empty and dark operating room. The huge space was completely silent. In the end, only Arang, who was pretending to be on duty, and Polly, who was still imprisoned and full of anxiety, were left.
The surroundings were completely silent, except for the subtle breathing of the two men, which echoed softly in the empty room. Arang leaned forward slightly, put his face close to Polly's ear, held his breath, and whispered softly at a volume that only two people could hear: "Girl."
The sudden soft whisper in her ears broke the dead silence, making Polly's heart suddenly tighten, and she suddenly raised all her vigilance. She suppressed the panic and fear surging in her heart, tried to steady her trembling breathing, and asked in a low voice, "What's wrong?"
"Don't talk, don't make any noise. Follow me and I will take you out of here." Arang's tone was particularly calm and determined, without any hesitation. His eyes were full of firm goodwill and determination to rescue. At the same time, he tilted his head slightly and used his eyes to signal Polly to cooperate with his actions.
Polly was smart and astute, and she instantly understood the deep meaning and hidden kindness in Arang's eyes, and immediately realized that the person in front of her had risked her life to sneak in to rescue her. The sudden hope in the desperate situation made her tense mind relax a little. She immediately struggled hard to straighten her body and sit up straight, eager to get up and follow him to escape from this place. But the surroundings were as dark as ink, and she couldn't see her fingers. The rich darkness completely blocked all sight. She couldn't distinguish the surrounding environment and the direction of travel, and it was difficult to move forward.
The boundless darkness, wrapped in unknown fear, once again seized Polly's mind, making her increasingly panicked and helpless. She frowned slightly, with obvious timidity and confusion in her voice, and said softly: "I...I can't see anything, and I don't know what to do at all."Where to go. "
“Don’t be afraid, don’t panic, reach out and hold my hand. I have been operating in darkness all year round and have long been accustomed to such boundless darkness, so I don’t have to worry about getting lost. Move faster, hurry up, we must leave here completely before those people finish repairing the lights and turn back. "Arang's tone was calm and gentle, trying to comfort the panicked Polly with every word, while urging her to seize the fleeting opportunity to escape.
The moment the words fell, Arang took the initiative to raise his arm, stretched out his palm, and steadily handed it to Polly. Without hesitation, Polly immediately raised her hand and grasped the warm and steady hand tightly. The warmth and firm strength from her palm instantly calmed most of her fears. The two of them held their breath in a tacit understanding, not daring to make any sound. Under the cover of darkness and under the guidance of Arang, they quickly and quietly evacuated the dangerous operating room.
At the same time, in Zhang Fo's laboratory at the other end, the atmosphere of the confrontation was still tense to the extreme, without letting up at all. After the lights went out, the atmosphere here became more depressing and stagnant. The writer looked at everything happening quietly in the darkness outside the window, knowing that his little trick had worked, but he deliberately pretended to be embarrassed and confused on his face. Pretending to be flustered, he raised his hands to gather the messy corners of his clothes, with a perfectly apologetic look on his face. He tried to cover up his deliberate secret operation with a clumsy illusion, and explained in a low voice: "I don't understand why I became so clumsy and slow today. I guess I accidentally hit the switch of the equipment and accidentally touched the line. "
